tha-ap193:1.1: Kuṭajapupphiyavaggo ekūnavīsatimo. [191. Tamālapupphiya.] Cullāsītisahassāni thambho sovaṇṇayo ahu / devalaṭṭhipaṭibhāgaṃ vimānaṃ me sunimmitaṃ. // //
tha-ap193:2.1: Tamālapupphaṃ paggayha vippasannena cetasā / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap193:3.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ kammam akariṃ tadā / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap193:4.1: Ito vīsatime kappe Candatitto ti ekako / sattaratanasampanno cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap193:6.1: Itthaṃ sudaṃ āyasmā Tamālapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
